name: test-driven-development
description: Enforce the RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle. Write failing tests first, implement minimum code to pass, refactor only when green. Includes test pyramid (80% unit / 15% integration / 5% e2e), DAMP over DRY for tests, and the Beyoncé Rule (if you liked it, put a test on it). Inspired by superpowers and agent-skills.

inputs.name: behavior
inputs.description: The behavior to implement, described as 'should [X] when [Y]'.

outputs.name: testResult
outputs.description: Test run result: passed, failed, errorCount.

failureConditions.signal: implementation file modified before test file
test passes on first run (RED phase not reached)
